verdict.rationale: Dependency tracking is a fair question for a work-management platform like monday.com, so the axis applies. However, no first-party evidence documents dependency columns, cross-board item linking, or launch-level dependency views. The nearest items are adjacent and earn no credit: AI risk-spotting (monday-docs-22) is a different feature, and building custom board views (monday-docs-3) is a developer building block. A community complaint that linking tickets in Monday is unreliable reinforces the absence of a documented, working capability.
